rows.commentary: 0.5: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers back of a length, angling across, allowing Shafali Verma to punch it down to sweeper cover for a single.
0.6: Nomvelo Sibanda loses control as the ball slips from her hand, delivering a high full-toss that is signalled a no ball, setting up a free hit.
0.6: Nomvelo Sibanda offers a slower, fuller delivery right in the slot, which Pratika Rawal picks cleanly and lofts through the line over the in-field to long-off for four.
1.1: Tendai Makusha hits a sharp length right on the money, nipping back in sharply as Shafali Verma blocks it watchfully.
1.2: Tendai Makusha probes on a length with inward movement, catching an early closed bat-face from Shafali Verma that trickles away off the outer half.
1.3: Tendai Makusha serves it full and wide, forcing Shafali Verma to reach out and slice her shot square of the wicket on the off-side for a single.
1.4: Tendai Makusha angles a full delivery in, prompting Pratika Rawal to step forward and drive it firmly towards the covers for one.
1.5: Tendai Makusha searches for control, pushing the delivery wide of the off-stump to Shafali Verma who lets it drift past.
1.5: Tendai Makusha completely misses her radar again with a delivery launched wide outside off, conceding back-to-back wides.
1.5: Tendai Makusha serves up a full and wide opportunity, but Shafali Verma can only find the fielder at sweeper cover for a single.
1.6: Tendai Makusha corrects her line to end the over on a length close to the off-stump, leaving Pratika Rawal to flash hard and miss as it comes in too close to the body.
2.1: Nomvelo Sibanda pitches full outside off and angles it further away, leaving Shafali Verma to watch it pass safely.
2.1: Nomvelo Sibanda delivers a back-of-a-length ball on off, and Shafali Verma steers it cleanly toward sweeper cover for a single.
2.2: Nomvelo Sibanda drops it full and angled across the batter, allowing Pratika Rawal to drive it securely out to sweeper cover for one.
2.3: Nomvelo Sibanda offers up a tempting full-toss that Shafali Verma violently lifts over the infield toward deep mid-wicket, bouncing once directly over the ropes for four.
2.4: Nomvelo Sibanda strikes as Shafali Verma holes out, with Nyasha Gwanzura safely claiming the catch to dismiss the batter for eight.
13.4: Loryn Phiri tosses it up in the slot, and Pratika Rawal leans onto the delivery, creaming it through the gap between mid-off and covers all the way to the boundary for four.
13.5: Loryn Phiri flighting it well on middle, and Pratika Rawal simply pushes the ball right back toward the bowler for a dot.
13.6: Loryn Phiri pulls back her length, allowing Pratika Rawal to step back and carve the ball away to deep extra cover for a single.
14.1: Michelle Mavunga strays onto the pads, and Pratika Rawal works it smoothly into the gap as the pair completes two runs.
14.2: Michelle Mavunga delivers it full and outside off, and Pratika Rawal steers her drive straight toward the covers.
14.3: Michelle Mavunga pulls her length slightly shorter on middle, prompting Pratika Rawal to punch off the back foot into the off-side.
14.4: Michelle Mavunga bowls fullish on off, Pratika Rawal taps it to mid-off to scamper through a quick single while beating the shy at the bowler's end.
14.5: Michelle Mavunga induces a mix-up as Harmanpreet Kaur plays it towards wide mid-on for a hurried single while Pratika Rawal tracks the flight of the ball.
14.6: Michelle Mavunga drops fractionally shorter, letting Pratika Rawal punch off the back foot to sweeper cover.
15.1: Loryn Phiri loops it up on off, and Pratika Rawal drives the ball firmly toward the cover fielder.
15.2: Loryn Phiri fires a full one too far into the slot, and Pratika Rawal punishes it past the fielders to sweeper cover, bringing up the team hundred in style.
15.3: Loryn Phiri tosses it up once more, and Pratika Rawal calmly strokes it down the ground to long-off for a single.
15.4: Loryn Phiri serves up a full-toss on the pads, which Harmanpreet Kaur flicks away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
15.5: Loryn Phiri drifts it too full on off, allowing Pratika Rawal to ease the delivery straight down to long-off.
15.6: Loryn Phiri drops it too short outside off, prompting Harmanpreet Kaur to step back and cut it toward sweeper cover.
16.1: Michelle Mavunga pitches fullish on middle, drilled straight back by Harmanpreet Kaur to crash into the bowler's stumps.
16.2: Michelle Mavunga keeps it full on middle, and Pratika Rawal simply pushes the ball right back to the bowler.
16.3: Michelle Mavunga angles one in from outside off, taking the inside half of Pratika Rawal's bat toward mid-wicket.
16.4: Michelle Mavunga digs it a fraction shorter outside off, safely cut away to point by Harmanpreet Kaur.
16.5: Michelle Mavunga targets back of a length outside off, guided deftly to third man by a late-playing Harmanpreet Kaur.
16.6: Michelle Mavunga finishes the over as Pratika Rawal nudges the delivery toward cover.
29.6: Olinder Chare strays down the leg-side, allowing Deepti Sharma to sink to one knee and sweep the loose offering firmly away to the boundary fence.
30.1: Nyasha Gwanzura drops it on a length outside off and Harmanpreet Kaur steps forward to smother it down.
30.2: Nyasha Gwanzura serves up a floated delivery in the slot outside off, which Harmanpreet Kaur reaches for and drives crisply straight to cover.
30.3: Nyasha Gwanzura targets off-stump, and Harmanpreet Kaur stays rooted in her crease to cut the ball directly to backward point.
30.4: Nyasha Gwanzura digs in a short delivery down the leg-side, resulting in a pull shot toward deep backward square for a single.
30.5: Nyasha Gwanzura offers width outside off, tempting Deepti Sharma into a cut that she mistimes toward the cover fielder.
30.6: Nyasha Gwanzura watches as Deepti Sharma sweeps the ball wide of deep backward square, settling for a single after a hesitant passage of running between the wickets.
31.1: Olinder Chare pitches it wide outside off, and Deepti Sharma slaps the ball hard but hits it straight to extra cover.
31.2: Olinder Chare gifts a juicy full toss that Deepti Sharma steps out to meet, miscues her intended slog through the midwicket region, and scampers a single.
31.3: Olinder Chare fires it short outside off, catching Harmanpreet Kaur swinging hard at a cut shot that she fails to time, securing just a single through the covers.
31.4: Olinder Chare provides width outside off once more, and Deepti Sharma patiently waits back to punch it piercingly through the off-side ring for a boundary.
31.5: Olinder Chare delivers a length ball on off-stump, prompting Deepti Sharma to drop back and punch it down to long-on for a single.
31.6: Olinder Chare serves an overpitched delivery outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur shovels it straight to short midwicket.
32.1: Nyasha Gwanzura strays down the leg-side, allowing Deepti Sharma to drop to one knee and sweep it fine past a desperate diving effort.
32.2: Nyasha Gwanzura bowls down the leg-side once more, and Deepti Sharma cashes in by sweeping it very fine past the wicketkeeper for another boundary.
32.3: Deepti Sharma works Nyasha Gwanzura cleanly off her pads into the square leg region to pick up a single.
32.4: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses it up on off stump, and Harmanpreet Kaur prods firmly down the pitch.
32.5: Harmanpreet Kaur gets forward to Nyasha Gwanzura and gently flicks the delivery through midwicket for a single.
32.6: Nyasha Gwanzura delivers an overpitched ball outside off, which Deepti Sharma drives down to long-off.
